name: Mimi curved idle sway with stronger hip travel
limits: Review-only candidate correcting v83's near-constant-speed sweep to a smooth curved cycle. From neutral it travels toward screen-right, eases at the extreme, then accelerates back through center toward screen-left and repeats.

Cycle is 5.108 seconds (1.5x the prior 0.82 rad/s rate). At strength 150 the normalized body driver remains bounded at ±1 to avoid clipped pose plateaus; the pelvis field itself expands from 16 to 22 native pixels at y590, with feet/ground anchors unchanged.
Rollback to motion_v83. This candidate is non-production and awaits visual user review.
